systems.system: Sistema de Gestão Autárquico (SGA), e-SISTAFE Autárquico component
systems.owner: CEDSIF, IP with the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of State Administration and Public Service and ANAMM
systems.tiers: pilot launched 21 February 2020 in three municipalities (Maputo City, Matola City, Boane town); at least 10 more targeted for 2020

note: A municipal financial-management system (expenditure planning and execution, accounts) piloted in 3 municipalities from 21 February 2020; revenue capture is named as an aim only, with no description of a payer or payment record, so no revenue-class fact.
